procedures.text: Potholes on arterial roads should be inspected within 24 hours when the hole exceeds 100 mm in diameter or intrudes into a traveled lane. Dispatch a crew with cold-mix for a temporary patch pending permanent repair.
procedures.triggering_conditions: pothole in a traveled lane on an arterial road

procedures.text: A pothole should be measured for diameter and depth before scheduling. Shallow potholes outside the traveled way are routine; those obstructing traffic warrant expedited response.
procedures.triggering_conditions: any pothole on a public right-of-way

procedures.text: Alligator cracking indicates structural fatigue in the pavement. Inspect for base failure, record extent and severity, and schedule for mill-and-overlay when area exceeds 10 square meters.
procedures.triggering_conditions: interconnected cracking on a traveled lane

procedures.text: Longitudinal cracks running parallel to the direction of travel are typically treated by routing and crack-sealing when width exceeds 3 mm. Monitor for progression into alligator cracking.
Transverse cracking is normally caused by thermal cycling. Seal cracks before winter and inspect for spalling. Not an urgent safety issue unless combined with potholing.
procedures.triggering_conditions: transverse crack across the direction of travel
